<div class="intro-lead">
  I'm a developer and writer who believes that explaining things clearly is the hardest—and most rewarding—part of the job.

I spend my days building data pipelines, exploring new frameworks, and trying to explain complex things in plain
language. This blog is where I share what I learn—including the mistakes.

When I'm not coding, I'm usually reading, hiking, or arguing about editors.

---

## 📝 What I Write About

In this blog, I explore the intersection of data engineering, software development, and technical communication. My articles range from deep dives into Python and SQL to tutorials on building modern web applications. I aim to break down complex architectural patterns and tools into digestible, actionable insights.

## 🎯 My Goal

The goal of this blog is to create a resource that I wish I had when I started my journey. I believe in the power of "learning in public"—by documenting my process and the challenges I face, I hope to help others avoid common pitfalls and inspire them to build their own projects. Writing forces me to understand topics more deeply, and my aim is to pass that clarity on to you.
